_comment: Default metadata rows rendered in the bottom panel, and the subset that is displayed per-sample (subdivided cells) rather than per-patient. These names must match the harmonized column names produced by Meta/SIF (see comutplotlib/meta.py) and the keys in the palette. Override via $COMUTPLOTLIB_CONFIG_DIR/meta_data_rows.json or the --meta-data-rows / --meta-data-rows-per-sample CLI flags.
